DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT
Off Calendar Sep-08-2006 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: Appearances:
Roberto Lobo Filho, 572-5188, plaintiff and responding party appearing in propria persona
Catherine M. Lee of Musick Peeler & Garrett, LLP, 281-2024, appearing for defendant and moving party

Argued and Ms. Lee presented the Court with a copy of the proof of service. The Court found the proof of service to be invalid and adopted its tentative ruling as follows: DEFENDANT CITIBANK (WEST) FSB'S DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT is overruled for invalid proof of service. "Causing" envelope to be mailed does not show proof of service by mail. Defendant will submit a proposed form of order. (301/PJB) Judge: Peter J. Busch, Reporter: Carol Karen, CSR 8189
